pages.name: The order
pages.text: When a sum mixes jobs, they go in a set [[order]]. Brackets, then powers, then times and divide, then add and take away. So in 1 + 2 × −3 the times goes first.

Across the top, the order: brackets, then powers, then times and divide, then add and take away; add and take away is highlighted. Beside it, the working: 1 plus 2 times minus 3, then equals 1 plus open bracket minus 6 close bracket, then equals minus 5. Highlighted: 1 plus open bracket minus 6 close bracket. pages.name: Which job first?
pages.task: In 6 + 12 ÷ −3, tap the job to do first.
pages.why: Divide comes before add, even with a negative, so 12 ÷ −3 = −4 goes first. Then 6 + (−4) = 2. Adding first would give 18 ÷ −3 = −6.

pages.name: Equal partners
pages.text: [[BIDMAS]], the school word for this order, lists A (add) before S (subtract). But add and take away are equal [[partners]], so go left to right. 1 − 4 + 2 takes away 4, then adds 2.

pages.name: Left to right
pages.why: BIDMAS puts A (add) before S (subtract), but add and take away are equal partners. Left to right, 8 − 3 = 5, then 5 + 2 = 7. Adding first would take away 5, not 3.

pages.name: Square, then the minus

pages.name: Take away a bracket
pages.why: Brackets first, 3 − 5 = −2. Then 10 − (−2), and taking away −2 adds 2, so it is 12. Dropping the brackets would give 10 − 3 − 5 = 2.
